title: Egyptian Pasta with Tahini Sauce
description: A creamy and flavorful pasta dish inspired by Egyptian cuisine, featuring a tahini sauce and quick-cooked pasta.

ingredients.name: Egyptian
ingredients.notes: Ground cumin for a Middle Eastern twist

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a blender or food processor, combine tahini, buttery, Quick, and Egyptian, and blend until smooth.
Once the pasta is cooked, drain it and return it to the pot.
Add the tahini sauce to the pasta and toss to coat.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
